resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal. The request is one flat edit of one layer and is at most 4096 encoded bytes, so a full effect stack that does not fit is refused, never split.

semantics: #2372: the baseline layer compositing writes of src/js/timeline.js and src/js/effects-panel.js @1065e9d8 as one native transaction per edit (the owner is scene_effect_layer_edit.rs). edit blend: picking Normal clears the member. matteMode: sets the first matte's mode, optionally freezing the source in the same write (the matte menu freezes the adjacent layer); the menu's None is matteClear, which removes the first matte and its additional mattes. matteSource: picking a source on a layer with no real mode sets alpha. matteMoreAdd/Set/Remove: the additional mattes (adding needs a matte that is on; removing the last removes the member). effects: replaces the layer's complete effect stack, so add, remove, reorder and toggle each send the full resulting stack; effectsFromSet/Clear borrow another layer's stack. folderCollapsed: folder layers only. A layer cannot matte itself or borrow its own stack; named layers must exist. One successful edit is one history entry and one revision; an edit that leaves the layer equal publishes nothing. Hover previews of the blend and matte pickers are UI-local and never reach this operation. No JS/Paper writer or fallback.
